title: Whole-operation standard DIMENSION subtype allocation rollback and retry
scope: Add all seven standard typed DIMENSION subtypes to the existing whole-operation ASCII/Binary allocation failure sweep.

commonFields.construction: Typed DRW_* dimension records serialized in the existing generated whole-operation drawing

allocationSweep.ascii: 624/624 offsets injected; previous destination, caller fields, and derived identity maps preserved; same-writer retry reproduced clean output and typed readback passed.
allocationSweep.binary: 617/617 offsets injected; previous destination, caller fields, and derived identity maps preserved; same-writer retry reproduced clean output and typed readback passed.

validation.readback: Exactly one callback was delivered for each standard subtype. Common text/style fields and subtype-specific WCS/OCS geometry match the typed profiles; generated handles are nonzero and remapped.

limitations: This verifies allocation rollback/retry and typed DXF roundtrip only; it does not qualify native dimension rendering or producer-specific DWG semantics.
DIMARC and custom/dynamic dimension profiles are not part of this seven-subtype control.
No full test suite was run.
fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was committed; the drawing is generated by the test in scratch storage.
